name: Replica Asset Image Generation
description: Extract used target entities from the localized storyboard, compile model-specific visual reference prompts, and render real managed reference images for characters, scenes and props.
when_to_use: CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD v2 exists and downstream video generation needs visual references
when_not_to_use: Localized storyboard is missing or stale

steps.title: 提取目标资产
steps.description: Collect only target characters/scenes/props actually referenced by the localized storyboard.

steps.title: 编译模型专属资产提示词
steps.description: Turn localized review facts into asset-local visual designs and Flux-specific execution prompts without changing stable target identity.

steps.title: 生成真实资产图
steps.description: Render managed image files, persist SHA/dimensions and bind them to stable target assets.

provider_rules: No text-only asset may satisfy the image contract
Every referenced target entity must receive at least one real reference image
Chinese review prose and image-model execution prompts are different contracts and must not be treated as the same text
The current Flux.1 Schnell adapter must compile concrete asset-local execution prompts before rendering
Prompt compilation may concretize visual design but may not change stable target identity, story facts, shot order or dialogue
Character prompts must request one head-to-toe person on a neutral studio background; scene prompts must request an empty environment; prop prompts must request one isolated object
Flux Schnell avoidance constraints must be folded into the positive execution prompt because the current CFG=1 workflow does not rely on a separate negative-conditioning prompt
Reference media must be persisted by Studio with SHA256 and dimensions
completion_criteria: Every referenced target entity has a Chinese reviewable visual design
Every referenced target entity has a model-specific image execution prompt
Every referenced target entity has real reference media
All media is managed and technically readable
failure_policy: Prompt compiler coverage mismatch fails closed before image rendering
Any required entity without a generated image blocks publication
Runtime failure does not replace an existing CURRENT asset revision
